newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel stocks bring up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Hotel stocks bring up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: Rising shares in the hotel sector brought gains in the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index Semdex which rose 1.95 points on Wednesday to 390.89.
Brokers said the volume transacted rose to 20.80 million rupees on 905,962 shares from 10.10 million rupees on 730,749 shares on Monday.
Sun Resorts was 1.50 rupees higher at 52 on 83,469 shares, New Mauritius Hotels gained 40 cents to 38 on 142,022 shares and Grand Baie Hotel climbed a rupee to 49.50 rupees on 6,300 shares.
"There has been buying interest on hotel stocks from foreign investors," said one broker.
In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 90 on 27,139 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 12 on 421,785 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Desert Alma (Ordinary) lost a rupee at 89.50 on 1,657 shares and Mon Desert Alma (Preferential) also eased a rupee to 88.00 rupees on 1,423 shares.

In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers was stable at 100 but was not traded. Ireland Blyth Ltd was also unchanged at 16.60 rupees on 17,237 shares. Happy World Foods rose 20 cents to 15.50 rupees on 12,769 shares.
Mauritius Development Investment Trust remained at 7.40 on 35,311 shares, Policy was stable at 4.15 on 36,000 shares and Fincorp was unchanged at 73 on 1,404 shares.
In the industry sector, Mauritius Oil Refineries was stable at 11.50 rupees on 101,500 shares and Mauritius Breweries Ltd was unchanged to 155.00 rupees on 1,892 shares
Air Mauritius remained at 38.90 rupees on 1,110 shares.
